name: Marovo Lagoon
story: Marovo Lagoon is the largest double-barrier enclosed lagoon in the world, covering 700 square kilometres in the Western Province of the Solomon Islands between Vangunu and Nggatokae islands. It is protected by a double barrier reef system and includes many islands where some people live and speak the Marovo language.
matters: The Marovo Lagoon World Heritage Area is considered an area of high biodiversity and conservation value, featuring high live coral cover in the Western Province.
